decoder_reset_only.interpretation: Decoder restoration alone does not resolve instability.

flow_reset_only.interpretation: Restoring only the pristine warm-start flow eliminates every waveform-level failure in all three tested seed schedules while preserving R1 decoder and DWC text-side learning.

decoder_and_flow_reset.interpretation: No acceptance advantage over flow-only reset; discards additional learned R1 decoder changes unnecessarily.

full_warm_acoustic_reset.interpretation: Inference output equals decoder+flow reset because posterior encoder enc_q is training-side only.

diagnosis.primary: R1 flow drift is the identified cause of the stochastic low-level machine-gate failures.
not_supported: simple inference-seed workaround as a valid solution
diagnosis.minimum_change_forward_hypothesis: Preserve the completed R1 model except restore model_g.flow.* from the exact verified warm-start. Validate that persisted hybrid checkpoint on the corrected unique acceptance set across at least five deterministic seed schedules before authorizing any R2 training. If promoted, freeze model_g.flow.* during R2 so the known-good flow cannot drift again.

authorization.next_operation: inference-only persisted R1-flow-restored hybrid checkpoint validation
